## Safety Checklist

- [ ] No real Amazon, Rocketcart, customer, or proprietary account data is included.
- [ ] Live write actions remain approval-gated with preflight, exact IDs, current/proposed values, readback, and monitoring.
- [ ] Missing data and confidence handling are explicit.
- [ ] BSR, TACoS, incrementality, and profitability claims are evidence-gated.
